summary: Comprehensive testing of No Limit Delivery app. Backend: 17/18 tests passing (94.4%). Frontend: Most features working but login navigation bug persists despite requestAnimationFrame fix attempt.

minor.issue: test_signup_new_user fails due to duplicate email (expected behavior - test user already exists)

integration_issues.issue: CRITICAL: Login button click does not navigate to home screen after successful authentication. API call succeeds (verified via backend tests), session token is stored, but router.replace('/home') is not executing. URL remains at /auth/login. The requestAnimationFrame fix in login.tsx (line 38-40) did NOT resolve the issue. User can access home screen directly via URL.
integration_issues.workaround: Users can navigate directly to /home after login, or app can auto-redirect on next load via authStore.loadUser()

integration_issues.issue: Addresses, Help, and Rewards screens show 'preview environment not responding' intermittently. Payment Methods, Notifications, and My Reviews load correctly.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' instead (React Native Web deprecation)
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix login navigation - router.replace() not working after successful login. Investigate Expo Router navigation in web preview. Consider alternative: use router.push() instead of router.replace(), or implement redirect in _layout.tsx based on auth state
Investigate loading issues for addresses, help, and rewards screens (may be related to Expo web preview environment)
Update shadow* style props to boxShadow across all components to remove deprecation warnings
Add testID attributes to tab navigation buttons for better automated testing
critical_code_review_comments: Login Navigation Bug: The requestAnimationFrame fix in login.tsx (line 38-40) did not resolve the navigation issue. The problem appears to be with Expo Router's router.replace() not executing in web preview after async state updates. Recommend trying: (1) router.push() instead of router.replace(), (2) window.location.href redirect, or (3) implementing auto-redirect in _layout.tsx based on isAuthenticated state

Profile Sub-Screens: Payment Methods, Notifications, and My Reviews work perfectly. Addresses, Help, and Rewards show intermittent loading issues - may be related to Expo web preview environment or component complexity
All backend APIs are fully functional - the login issue is purely a frontend routing problem
